text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(...I can do this! If I can just carry 
this momentum into the final stretch—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: The real battle starts now! —Hah!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOO! Not yet, not yet, not yeuut!

text_block_list.name: Blast & Lala
text_block_list.text: Ryaaaaaaaah! Yaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(!? She still has this much power 
left...?!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Kh... Taaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Crossing the finish line in first place 
now! The spring senior division 
medium-distance champion is—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Chrono's actually pretty good. I 
didn't think she'd make it this far!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Umamusume are polished and grow 
stronger through racing.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Great feats and records... they can't be 
made alone.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"If this is the result even with that 
advantage... Chrono-chan's next race is 
gonna be scary."

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: "I've gotta work way, way harder too!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ain't that the truth. We've both gotta 
give it our all.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The peers who ran shoulder-to-shoulder 
with Miss Eye. I thought I understood 
their prowess, but—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Facing her in the flesh on the turf... her 
presence was far greater than I'd 
anticipated...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Could this be the difference in 
experience...? The racing instincts and 
fighting spirit she honed through fierce 
competition with Ai-san and the others 
were far beyond my imagination...
choice_data_list:
A sensation you can only feel by running 
together, huh...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I suspect it is much the same for 
the older generations.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Even with the Genesis Method—Lara-san, we 
especially need to take the Genesis Factor 
into account."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Her challenge for the Triple Tiara after 
four consecutive undefeated wins... ended 
in tasting the bitter cup of defeat 
against Ms. Eye at every turn.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
For a while after, she was unable to win. 
Her reputation as the queen of her 
generation fell... How humiliating that 
must have felt...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Yet she endured... seizing victory 
through sheer tenacity and staging a 
miraculous comeback..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"The spirit I felt from her was an 
obsession with victory... Something I 
don't possess..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
If I compete for a year in the Senior 
Class, perhaps I too might reach that same 
state, but...

"Deficiencies can be compensated for. 
However, when it comes to experience, it's 
difficult. A full year of experience 
carries that much of a temporal 
advantage."

And this was something that I, who does 
not stand on the turf, could never have 
taught her...
choice_data_list:
Then... how about asking someone with 
experience for advice?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Huh? G-Grass-san, you're going to help 
us...?!
choice_data_list:
I asked just in case, and they actually 
said yes...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you sure...? Um... w-why did you 
agree to take this on...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The Grand Prix is a special race to me as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There were races... I couldn't run in, due 
to injuries and various other reasons.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to compete for the pinnacle in 
the royal road GⅠs with Spe-chan and the 
others... but I couldn't."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The support from all the fans was what 
encouraged and sustained me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The feelings poured into the fan votes... 
They sympathized with my frustration, and 
wanted to see a showdown between me and 
Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The Grand Prix is a dream race where the 
hopes of Umamusume and fans unite.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If I can be of any help in livening up 
that stage, I would be more than happy to 
cooperate.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Grass-san...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
First, allow me to share the areas for 
improvement I've noticed, along with 
solutions for them.

Saying she had an idea, Grass Wonder led 
me to an open-air tea ceremony setup.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The greatest thing cultivated through 
racing experience is the refinement of 
one's spirit.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... Historically speaking, 
spiritual growth is often discussed, isn't 
it...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
For example, presence comes from mastery 
of the "still" spirit, while fighting 
spirit comes from mastery of the "active" 
spirit. We will hone both sides of this 
coin.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
First, through sado—the way of tea— let us 
cultivate a calm, unflappable mind.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It is fine to observe and grasp your 
surroundings. However, do not let your 
heart waver.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...My heart is completely calm.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(A tranquil heart, a tranquil heart... 
Like a calm sea. Calm your mind...)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—Chrono-chan, your mind is unsettled. Try 
to relax and don't overthink things.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...! R-Relax...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Next is the fighting spirit to take on 
battle.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Why do you want to win, Chrono-chan? 
Please picture what it is you want to 
achieve through racing."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(...What I want to accomplish... To 
conquer the Grand Prix, and leave my 
hoofprints in history...)
choice_data_list:
(I'll carve our hoofprints into history 
with back-to-back Grand Prix victories!)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...It is difficult to suddenly match 
Lala-chan's level of obsession. However, 
Chrono-chan, within you as well, there 
must be an intense desire—a true passion."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Stir it up, fan the flames within. Only 
then... will you be able to match his 
obsession."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"If the passion won't surge within you... 
Ah, perhaps looking at your Trainer might 
help."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Huh...? —Ah.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(T-Their eyes... it's like they're 
screaming for back-to-back Grand Prix 
victories...)
choice_data_list: Hm? Oh, I'm the switch? Got it!
Hm? Oh, I'm the switch? Got it!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (Yes, I... want to win too!)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...It seems you're ready. Now then—let us 
hone it even further!"

And so, we continued our mental discipline 
and honed our skills. Meanwhile, Grass 
Wonder also helped stir up excitement for 
the Grand Prix fan vote.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, I'm so nervous... No matter how 
many interviews I do, I just can't get 
used to them.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, this interview is just with me 
today. Take it easy, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, this column's going out to the 
public, right? I have to make sure I don't 
say anything weird!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...T-To think the day would come where 
I'd hear about the Grand Prix showdown 
directly from you...!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A-And what's more... it's an interview 
format...! They might reveal true feelings 
that would usually be dodged in a solo 
interview...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you so much for sharing such 
valuable insights...!
choice_data_list: Looks like the interview went really well.
Looks like the interview went really well.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I heard far too many stories to fit 
into just a single column...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Wh-What if we put this on display 
for the Fan Thanksgiving festival...?
choice_data_list: I think that's a great idea!

text_block_list.text:
The Fan Appreciation Festival is an event 
where Umamusume and fans can interact. 
It's the perfect opportunity to encourage 
fan vote participation.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I have a suggestion regarding the external 
column—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
How about publishing the article under the 
pen name 'Chrono-chan'?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: U-Under my real name...?

She hasn't revealed that "Writer C" is 
Chrono Genesis. Even her external columns 
are under the name of the Academy PR 
Committee.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"As Chrono-chan was saying, the true 
atmosphere of a race can only be felt by 
the Umamusume who run in it."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The fans have no way of knowing just how 
formidable Lala-chan and Blast-chan truly 
are.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
How about conveying what "modern racing" 
is like while incorporating such realistic 
impressions?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"What the fans want to know most about 
right now is Chrono-chan and the others 
who are racing♪"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...T-That's true. However... if I write 
it, the perspective might be biased..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
If we have another writer review it... 
I-I'll go consult the committee...!
choice_data_list: Oh, that's a really positive attitude!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... What kind of hoofprints... do I 
want to leave in history?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Because I could see that image clearly 
within myself.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...To become an Umamusume who has mastered 
the Grand Prix. I will press on 
relentlessly... to make that a reality...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Our next goal is the Takarazuka Kinen... 
We can't afford to get complacent...!
